who_we_are: Prestige Holidays 4U is a Bengaluru-based travel agency that plans domestic and international holidays the old-fashioned way: a real person on WhatsApp who knows the route, asks the right questions, and builds the trip around your dates, your budget and your pace. We're small on purpose — every itinerary that leaves our office has been shaped by someone you can call back.
mission: To make well-planned travel feel personal again — honest itineraries, clear communication before and during the trip, and holidays matched to the people taking them rather than templates.
vision: To be the travel partner Bengaluru families and couples recommend to each other — trusted enough that your next trip starts with a WhatsApp message to us, not a search engine.

core_values.name: Straight answers
core_values.description: We tell you what a destination is really like in your travel month — including when the answer is 'wait two months and it'll be twice as good.'

core_values.name: Personal planning
core_values.description: Every trip is built person-to-person on WhatsApp or a call — no bots, no ticket queues.

core_values.name: Support that travels with you
core_values.description: The number you booked with is the number that answers while you're away.

core_values.name: No surprises
core_values.description: What's included and what's not is agreed before you pay — omissions spelled out, not discovered.
